title.narrative: The Integrated emergency response for most venerable IDPs in NW Syria -Envelop 1

description.narrative: MHD (Muzun for Humanitarian amp Development) aim through this intervention to save lives, foster safety in IDPs sites, and strengthen access to key institutions and services through implementing CCCM activities inter-linked to CASH for Winterization activities in both Aleppo and Idleb Governorates by taking into consideration the different needs of men, women, boys, and girls, in addition, special needs of disabled people in all the project activities. MHD has designed this proposal to target 159,837 beneficiaries (37958 out of them are women), 31300HHs in NW Syria in 48 camps (see Annex 1- updated beneficiaries and locations ) under CCCM Clusters activities. Muzun has coordinated with Takaful Al Sham organization and SNFI Cluster(see Annex 2) to implement CCCM activities in the same locations that TAS will distribute Cash for winter to ensure complementarity intervention in those locations. As per the recent CCCM Cluster report related to incidents in NWS (Annex 3), the Fire incidents has impacted 145 sites, causing the destruction of of 226 shelters during the second half of 2022 ,therefore, Muzun main objective under CCCM intervention is Emergency Preparedness and Fire Response in NWS through implementing (Trainings and awareness raising ,Establishing fire points, Providing fire response resources including fire extinguishers and first aid kits and Refilling the used fire extinguishers) in 48 IDPs in North West Syria. It's worth to mention that Muzun has a Site Monitoring Team in NWS and implement tracking and monitoring project in close coordination with CCCM Cluster to provide immediate reports related incidents and displacements which will complementary with the proposed project. The project has prepared based under CCCM standards and in line with Fire prevention and mitigation TWiG guidance taking into account the prioritized locations and objectives of SCHF 2nd Standard allocation. Over and above , Muzun will cover the needs of PwDs , women and older adults through consulting them during the project implementation and facilitating their access to life-saving services especially for the locations of Fire points inside the camps , which will strengthen their sense of security and safety. As a result , Muzun will maintain the humanitarian and protection principles among the beneficiaries in the targeted IDPs sites, especially do no harm principle.
